integrity: Explicit proof by canonical flags and double subspace-Mobius inversion; finite small-field verification is corroboration, not proof. Historical priority is not independently established.
scientific_limitations: Counts labeled n-dimensional modules, not isomorphism classes or full-scheme multiplicity. Earlier literature classifies some irreducible components and unrefined counts. Possible implicit equivalent refinements in Hall-algebra and quiver enumeration literature remain a priority risk. The reduced rank strata are smooth; no assertion of reducedness for the full representation scheme.
title: Joint radical-image and socle-codimension strata for square-zero local algebras
